Immutable Memory Traces (execution evidence + provenance, repository state, entity bindings to files/symbols/tests, Memory Anchor); Memory Trace Graph (depend, verify, correct, supersede relations); Repository State Graph (files, symbols, tests; defines, calls, imports, covers); trace-entity projection; Trace Synopses; checkpoint of execution frontier. Seal completed units of work as traces -> offload trace bodies under context pressure, keep anchors and synopses -> before context refresh checkpoint frontier and anchors -> after refresh reconstruct frontier via MTG, locate entities via RSG and projection (<=2 MTG hops), validate applicability (aligned and not superseded) -> selectively restore within budget, else re-read or re-run (Algorithm 1)

fields.v: Tasks: DeepSWE (113), SWE-EVO (46), SWE-Milestone (98 milestones). Configurations: 2 harnesses x {Native, Obs. Masking, RepoGraph, MemTrace} + 4 ablations. Baseline: Native. Held constant: backbone model and harness within each setting, context window, no step limit. Acceptance: benchmark tests and official scoring. Repetitions: Not stated (apparently single run). Human intervention: none

Quality: MemTrace best primary metric in every benchmark-harness setting: DeepSWE pass@1 +21.2 (Codex) / +17.7 (mini) points over best baseline; SWE-EVO Resolved +4.4 / +10.8; SWE-Milestone Score +17.8 / +13.8. Partial-progress metrics mixed: Obs. Masking higher Fix Rate than MemTrace under Codex (72.1 vs 70.6); MemTrace lower Apply under mini (93.5 vs 97.8). Baselines sensitive to harness (Obs. Masking +17.4 over Native under Codex, -28.3 under mini on SWE-EVO). Cost (wall-clock, Table 6): MemTrace slower than Native under Codex (DeepSWE 54.17 vs 42.02 min; SWE-EVO 82.05 vs 30.00) but faster under mini-swe-agent (75.30 vs 103.77; 114.03 vs 170.97). No significance tests on performance

rev.why: Draft omitted the cost dimension: Table 6 wall-clock times show MemTrace slower than Native under Codex CLI and faster under mini-swe-agent

fields.v: Distinguished MemTrace from baselines with large margins, but single runs and no uncertainty on performance; strong harness-dependence of baselines noted. Ablation shows RSG matters on DeepSWE but not on SWE-EVO. No limitations of the comparison discussed by the authors

No limitations or threats section. Future work: more backbone models and context-window sizes; persistent multi-task, multi-session settings in the same repository. Implementation scope: RSG symbol-level only for Python, file-level for other languages

No pre-registration. Languages: six (Python, TypeScript, Go, JavaScript, Rust in DeepSWE; Java in SWE-Milestone)
